items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Later I heard that the reason Django did not show up for the concert was because he happened to meet Marcel Cerdan, the French boxer...

ctx.x: I decided to go and see Django for a few minutes as Carnagie Hall was only a few blocks from the Zanzibar. When I arrived, the atmosphere back stage was not very brilliant, and I was told that Django had not shown up for the concert. I was disappointed because I had visioned a happy but short reunion in which I could perhaps persuade Django to come to the Zanzibar and meet the musicians I was working with, after he had finished his concert.

Later I heard that the reason Django did not show up for the concert was because he happened to meet Marcel Cerdan, the French boxer, and as he was lonesome, he was so happy to be able to speak French that he started drinking with Marcel and forgot about the concert. However, it was said that Django did arrive later, but had no guitar and was not dressed formally for the concert.

We recorded for a new record company called MGM which I think was affiliated with the movie company. This date was with the band and there were numbers where some vocals were done by Sy and Dickie Wells, Henri Wells and the whole orchestra. Sy was keen on the 'Glee Club Style' of singing and knew the technique of it. He had done it with the Lunceford orchestra successfully and on a few numbers with the Dorsey band.
